sources.snippet: We introduce EXAONE-3.-7.8B-Instruct, a pre-trained and instruction-tuned bilingual (English and Korean) generative model with 7.8 billion parameters. The model was pre-trained with 8T curated tokens and post-trained with supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. It demonstrates highly competitive benchmark performance against other state-of-the-art open models of similar size.
